title: City of Laredo sets political forums for District 8 race and mayoral runoff
excerpt: The City of Laredo will hold two candidate forums at City Hall: the District 8 City Council forum on Thursday, November 12, and the mayoral runoff forum on Wednesday, November 18. Both start at 6:30 p.m.
content:
The City of Laredo has scheduled two political forums so residents can hear directly from the candidates before they vote, the city announced Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as part of Laredo Votes 2026.

The forum for the City Council District 8 special election is set for Thursday, November 12, at 6:30 p.m. The forum for the mayoral runoff election follows on Wednesday, November 18, at 6:30 p.m.

Both forums will be held in the City Hall Council Chambers, 1110 Houston St., in downtown Laredo.

Residents can watch either forum live on the City of Laredo Government Facebook page, the City of Laredo Municipal Channel on YouTube, Swagit, or Spectrum Channel 1300.

The mayoral runoff on Saturday, December 12, will decide between District 8 Council Member Alyssa Cigarroa and incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño. Cigarroa led the November 3 vote with 19,510 votes (35.54 percent), while Treviño finished second with 17,725 votes (32.29 percent).

Source: City of Laredo – Government, November 10, 2026.
